event_id.description: The ID of the event requested

Accept-Language.description: The language to use for the response. Defaults to 'en'.

If-None-Match.description: The ETag of the previous request. A 304 will be returned if this matches the current ETag.

X-Compatibility-Date.description: The compatibility date for the request.

X-Tenant.description: The tenant ID for the request. Defaults to 'tranquility'.
